text:
Your vault is encrypted on your device before anything is sent to our servers. When you enter your master password, the app runs it through PBKDF2, a key-derivation function, 600,000 times to produce your encryption key. All those rounds make each password guess slow and expensive, so anyone trying to brute-force your master password has to do a lot of work for every attempt.

The app then uses that key to encrypt your vault with AES-256, a widely trusted encryption standard. Without the right key, nobody can read the encrypted data.

Our servers never see your master password. They store only your encrypted vault, which nobody can read without your key, and that includes us. If our servers were ever breached, attackers would get scrambled data and no way to decrypt it.

Your master password is the only thing that unlocks your vault, and since we never see it, keeping it safe is your job. Make it long and unique, and don't share it with anyone.
